Turn an AI creature clip into motion for a 3D character.

Give it front-and-side views together. It extracts the movement and applies it to your prepared character.

transkript.t: This AI spider just became a 3D animation.
Not another clip you can only watch.
A character you can open in Blender.
You set up your character, then give it a clip showing the front and side together.
It pulls out the movement and puts it onto that character.
The spider rears up in the video.
There's a setup and generating the clips costs less than a coffee.
